comment_text: When I, as a single mother with a son who graduates this year and a child I have guardianship of has to work 2 jobs and still go without a meal from day to day …. Something is wrong. Before Trump we were doing ok. I didn’t need 2 jobs and all 3 of us are 3 meals a day or at least the meals we wanted to. Now, I go entire days without eating at least 2-3 days a week so I know my children will be able to eat. My son almost dropped out of high school to help me with bills this winter. Hence me now working 2 jobs. Some weeks I am working 70-80 hours in 1 week. This is crazy something has to give and it can’t be the every day American
